historical_plan_cost_configuration.adaptation_optimizer_accounting: unchanged complete per-step operator inventory; explicit initial parameter/existing-moment finite scans charged and reserved per candidate; allocation, binding, compilation and every dispatch remain inside actual complete CPU; bitwise handmade update equivalence required, no a priori speed or content benefit
historical_plan_cost_configuration.build_cpu_attribution: entire system build CPU including shared preparation, all three seeds and LR search, divided by three selected seeds; each selected seed serves H requests
historical_plan_cost_configuration.preparation_forecast_rule: retain three actual TRAIN preparation CPU samples per seed/mode; for m future preparations estimate m*median(samples)+max(0,max(samples)-median(samples)); same formula for every arm, not a charge or cap guarantee; all actual work remains fully charged

metadata_extraction_meter.boundary: Current process: after stdlib imports through hashing, extraction, validation and payload construction; final JSON/Markdown serialization/writes and interpreter startup excluded. Final tool receipt meters this process through both writes. No child/model process was used.
metadata_extraction_meter.incomplete_preliminary_metering: One read-only nested inventory final console meter was not retrieved. An initial publication guard exited 1 before writing files because it mistook the legitimate budgets.kernels.base_decoder.decoder_mse cost-kernel name for an outcome field; no model/data action occurred. These two costs, shell/tool orchestration and publication I/O outside stated boundaries remain external administrative R&D, are not zero and are not subtracted.
